pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with jagged, high-angularity margins. Individual units exhibit soft pixel gradients at the edges. Patch area is largest on the central flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented units towards the lower limbs and neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of wide, light-colored corridors separating the patches. The topological graph features clear junction nodes where three to four corridors intersect. Pathway thickness is high and remains consistent across the visible mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-profile mane visible along the dorsal midline, showing a consistent high-frequency serrated silhouette composed of dark vertical hair fibers.
